name: vistacode
description: Interactive C/C++ control-flow flowchart with drag-and-drop layout

scripts.copy:assets: node -e "const{cpSync,mkdirSync}=require('fs'); mkdirSync('dist/wasm',{recursive:true}); const wp=require.resolve('web-tree-sitter'); cpSync(wp.replace('web-tree-sitter.js','tree-sitter.wasm'),'dist/wasm/tree-sitter.wasm'); const rp=require.resolve('@resvg/resvg-wasm'); cpSync(rp.replace('index.js','index_bg.wasm'),'dist/wasm/resvg.wasm'); ['c','cpp'].forEach(l=>cpSync(require.resolve('tree-sitter-wasms/out/tree-sitter-'+l+'.wasm'),'dist/wasm/tree-sitter-'+l+'.wasm'));"
scripts.build: npm run generate:icon && npm run build:extension && npm run build:webview && npm run copy:assets
